items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I saw Papa Joe Jones when he played for us, with Milt Buckner.

ctx.x: Who was Big Sid with at that time, when you saw him?

Oh, I don’t remember. I think he might have been sitting in with Basie or something, I’m not sure. I saw Papa Joe Jones when he played for us, with Milt Buckner. Of course Philly Joe Jones played for us many times, and he was great. He was mashugana but he was great, you know. [Laughs] You know, you mentioned Stan Levey some time ago; yes he was very good too. Tiny Kahn was wonderful.

I met Stan in - was it Redondo Beach? - And he had since, long since given up playing the drums. Actually, his... actually I think he stopped then, but he had transitioned from being a professional musician to actually taking up photography and opening up a studio.
